item.title: ‘Brave from the beginning’: 20 years of Friday Night Lights – the sports drama that dared to be different
item.description: It launched the careers of Jesse Plemons and Michael B Jordan, and let its stars improvise in a way that was fresh and new. This show about smalltown US football was confident, trailblazing – and wonderful I’ve been around the south of the US enough to have seen the importance of football: little burgs where the high-school football field has stands that wouldn’t disgrace a League Two soccer club in the UK. Friday Night Lights, which was first broadcast 20 years ago, is set in the most fervent edges of that world, smalltown Texas, where what happens under the floodlights at the end of the… Fuente: The Guardian - Culture.

Por eso, si el usuario de Twitter Stefan Francisci (bueno, de X, vale ya con los nombres) propone el juego de “ toma este mapa e inventa fronteras sin enfadar a nadie ”, nos viciamos. item.title: Bruce Baird, former federal Liberal MP and NSW minister, dies aged 84
item.description: Baird, father of former NSW premier Mike Baird and journalist Julia Baird, helped win the Olympics for Sydney Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Bruce Baird, a former federal Liberal MP and deputy leader of the party’s New South Wales branch, has died aged 84. Baird, who also served as the NSW transport minister from 1988 to 1995, is the father of former state premier Mike Baird, the ABC journalist Julia Baird, and the marketing executive Steve Baird. Sign up for Guardian Australia’s Politics, really newsletter here Continue reading... Publicado también por: ABC News Australia. Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: La emotiva despedida de Messi: sus compañeros le dejan un mensaje en una camiseta
item.description: Los jugadores de la Selección Argentina quisieron tener un detalle muy especial con Leo Messi en su despedida. Cada uno de sus compañeros escribió un mensaje personal en una camiseta que posteriormente le entregarán al capitán, como recuerdo de todos los momentos compartidos con la Albiceleste y de una etapa histórica que llega a su final. Fuente: Marca.
